notes.title: TAPE: Unveil the Memories Hi-Fi Edition!
notes.content:

[h1]TAPE: Unveil the Memories Hi-Fi Edition![/h1]

[b]TAPE: Unveil the memories[/b], a game developed by [b]BlackChiliGoat Studio[/b], awarded in several contests and predestined to become a cult work. The fantastic mystery video game set in Spain in the 90's, is available from today in the [b]special bundle[/b] "[b]Hi-Fi Edition[/b]" that includes the video game and the excellent soundtrack both in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910320/TAPE_Unveil_the_Memories/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/234878]PlayStation Store[/url]. And besides, you can also get your hands on TAPE: Unveil the Memories for [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/tape-unveil-the-memories-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url]. 

Remember that the strengths of this game lie in the [b]originality of its mechanics and its narrative[/b]. A fantastic game set in the deep Galicia of the 90s, pure nostalgia style [b]Twin Peaks[/b]. In it you will find puzzles that will force you to [b]explore reality and modify the past[/b] to understand the present.

We are in Antumbria. The young Iria, daughter of a horror film director, receives a distressing distress message from her father, inside a [b]VHS tape[/b]. that her father sends her with a distressing distress message. Thus begins the exploration of his own memory with the help of an old video camera capable of [b]revealing the secrets of the past and modifying the present[/b], making the elements of the scenario go back, forward or pause.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120843/6a3bcf65ae9ed5479fdd5e99dbd9f733120bcc9c.png[/img]

[*] A own narrative of the best Stephen King, which will delight mystery lovers, with [b]plot twist that will blow your mind[/b].
[*] [b]Original mechanics[/b]: never a puzzle will surprise you so much.
[*] Set in an enigmatic [b]scenario[/b] with which you will identify yourself.
[*] Excellent [b]sound[/b].
[*] Now available on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910320/TAPE_Unveil_the_Memories/]Steam[/url], [url=https://store.playstation.com/es-es/concept/234878]PS4, PS5[/url] and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/tape-unveil-the-memories-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url].

notes.title: "TAPE: Unveil the Memories" mysteries coming to Nintendo Switch!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120843/7cc2442f8920d8daa36b743ba941708deaa9e574.png[/img]

[h1]"TAPE: Unveil the Memories" mysteries coming to Nintendo Switch[/h1]

[i]TAPE: Unveil the Memories[/i] could be the most mysterious videogame ever developed in Spain, a cult work created by [i]BlackChiliGoat Studio[/i] and awarded in several contests.

The only thing that is not a mystery is its release date on Nintendo Switch: Good news! You have it [b]available on April 14[/b].

[previewyoutube=C7pYchxzD0M;full][/previewyoutube]
Now that you know its release date on Nintendo Switch, let's tell you everything you still don't know. That is, everything that hides the narrative of this fantastic game set in the deep Galicia of the late twentieth century. A Twin Peaks very ours, riddled with innovative mechanics that will force you to explore reality, outside the game, until you turn your head upside down

While in Seattle young people copy Nirvana tapes, in Antumbria, young Iria receives a much more important tape. A VHS her father sends her with a distress message. Who was her father? A famous horror film director. To help him, Iria will have to explore her own memory thanks to a very special tool: an old video camera with which she will discover the dangerous secrets lurking in her past. With the camera, she will be able to influence the environment, moving backwards, forwards or pausing the elements of the enviroment.

Featured content: 
[list]
[*] [b]Narrative[/b] typical of the best Stephen King, which will [b]delight mystery lovers[/b], with twists and turns that will blow your mind.
[*] [b]Original mechanics[/b]: never before has a puzzle surprised you so much.
[*] Set in an [b]enigmatic scenario[/b] with which you will identify.
[*] Excellent [b]OST[/b].
[*] [b]Available on [url=https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/tape-unveil-the-memories-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url] from April 14[/b], you can add it to your wishlist now.
[*] [b]Also available on PS4, PS5 and Steam[/b].
[/list]

notes.title: New Languages and Director's Cut Mode
notes.content:
We have been busy porting the game to PlayStation 5, but we have taken the opportunity to update the game with some improvements.

[b]4 NEW LANGUAGES.[/b][/b]

[i][b]Bonjour ma petite star....
Ciao, mia piccola stella....
Hallo mein kleiner Stern...
Olá, minha Pequena Estrela...[/b][/i]

Now you can enjoy [b]TAPE[/b] in 4 more languages: [b]French[/b], [b]Italian[/b], [b]German[/b] and [b]Portuguese[/b].

[b]FIXES IN DIRECTOR'S CUT[/b].

The [i][b]Director's Cut[/b][/i] mode that appears when you complete [b]TAPE[/b] for the first time has received some changes to make it easier for players to enjoy the different endings of the game. 
Now, you won't need to complete the entire last level, but you will be able to take the choices directly. No Spoilers!

Thank you for playing TAPE: Unveil the Memories!

The BCG team.

notes.title: Tape: Unveil the Memories is now available with a 20% launch discount.
notes.content:
Tape: Unveil the Memories is now available with a 20% launch discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910320/TAPE_Unveil_the_Memories/

Tape is a first-person psychological thriller set in the north of Spain in the 1990s where players will be able to use time to their advantage. 

Thanks to an old Super8 camera, Iria, the main character will be able to play with time to solve puzzles and try to remember the past events that led to her dad's disappearance, an acclaimed horror movie director. The game will challenge players to use the rewind mechanic to solve puzzles, escape the nightmares that inhabit Iria's memories while exploring an eerie location heavily influenced by her dad's work in the past.

notes.title: Release Date!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42120843/4558226b9e4b05412f51bcfd49a1cd61d58ec418.png[/img]

Hello!

We are proud to announce that TAPE: Unveil the Memories is coming to Steam and PlayStation on April 14th.

In TAPE, you will play as Iria, a girl who receives a VHS tape from her missing father asking for help. After this, Iria will find herself in the depths of her mind, where she can use her father's old video camera to interact with her memories, rewinding, fast-forwarding and pausing the objects she finds.

Using this time-affecting camera, Iria will be able to traverse her broken memories and uncover the secrets behind the tragic events that led to her father's disappearance.

You can now watch our announcement trailer with lots of new features and add TAPE to your Wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1910320/TAPE_Unveil_the_Memories/?beta=0
We hope you like it!

From the folks at BlackChiliGoat
